hardware_scope: One body; user confirmed FL2, FL3, ST photography and playback after battery removal. Portable frontend not independently hardware-tested.
colour_donor: ILCE-FX2 1.01 CP image and colour units (work/fx2-unpack, work/fx2_unit0{1,d}_CX9690*.bin); cross-checked against the published A7R V 4.04 values in r5_fl23_reference.json
colour_fill: all 48 block13 slots per look (3 light-source endpoints x 16 hue sectors) copied from the donor bank, plus the three CC1 differential groups
gamma_fill: 4 records: FL2/FL3 internal slots 0-5 (generation 5) and internal slot 6 (generation 6) both carry the FX2 photo slot-6 curve, so the photo tone matches the reference whichever record the body reads
gamma_route: cpapp-b.bin +0x138832 returns the appended route table (RAM 0x012099F8) without rewriting the CP colour index, so FL2/FL3 stills reach rows 48/49 instead of falling back to row 0

layout.workdir: workdir/ 下按「时间戳-机身短码」自动新建
layout.backup: backup/ 下按机身短码一份，写入后三层校验

gamma_movie_row: route entries 19/20 = (48,46)/(49,47): stills keep rows 48/49 with the FX2 photo slot-6 curve, movies use rows 46/47 with the FX2 movie slot-6 curve (max 122844/122753). Photo output is unchanged.
